product_description: AI-powered project management tool for software engineering teams that auto-prioritizes backlogs, detects sprint risks, and suggests optimal task assignments based on developer velocity and capacity.
business_objective: Replace manual sprint planning and backlog grooming for engineering teams at mid-market SaaS companies
icp: Series B-D SaaS companies, 50-500 engineers, using agile/scrum
user_persona: Software engineers and tech leads who attend sprint planning
existing_workflow: Teams manually groom backlog in Jira, estimate story points in planning poker, assign tasks in sprint planning meeting, then track progress in standups
